{{short description|Professor for Inorganic Chemistry}}

'''Kersti Hermansson''' (born in 1951) is a Professor for Inorganic Chemistry at [[Uppsala University]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=CV Hermansson|url=http://www.teoroo.kemi.uu.se/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/K.Hermansson.pdf|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-08-07|website=}}{{Dead link|date=May 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

== Education and professional career ==
She did her PhD on "The Electron Distribution in the Bound Water Molecule" in 1984.<ref name=":0" /> From 1984 to 1986, she had a postdoctoral fellowship from the Swedish Research Council with Dr. E. Clementi at IBM-Kingston, USA.<ref name=":0" /> From 1986–1988, she was a Högskolelektor in Inorganic Chemistry at [[Uppsala University]].<ref name=":0" /> In 1988, she was a docent of Inorganic Chemistry at [[Uppsala University]].<ref name=":0" /> In 1996, she was a Biträdande professor.<ref name=":0" /> Since 2000, she is a professor of Inorganic Chemistry at [[Uppsala University]].<ref name=":0" /> During this time (2008-2013), she was a part-time guest professor at [[KTH Royal Institute of Technology|KTH Stockholm]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
Her research focuses on condensed-matter chemistry including the investigation of chemical bonding and development of quantum chemical methods.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Research projects {{!}} Teoroo – Theoretical inorganic chemistry group|url=http://www.teoroo.kemi.uu.se/research/|access-date=2020-08-07|language=en-US|archive-date=2020-07-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200724061206/http://www.teoroo.kemi.uu.se/research/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Awards ==
She received several prizes for her research:

* "Letterstedska priset" from the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences|Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences]] (KVA) (1987)<ref name=":0" />
* "Oskarspriset" from Uppsala University (1988)<ref name=":0" />
* "Norblad-Ekstrand" medal in gold from the [[Swedish Chemical Society]] (2003)<ref name=":0" />
* Member of Kungl. Vetenskapssamhället (Academia regia scientiarum Upsaliensis, KVSU), Uppsala (since 1988)<ref name=":0" />
* Member of Royal Society of Science (since 2002)<ref name=":0" />
* Member of [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] (since 2007)<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Royal Swedish Academy of Science|url=https://www.kva.se/en/om-oss/kontakt/kersti-hermansson|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|website=}}{{Dead link|date=May 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* Adjunct professor at the [[Kasetsart University]], Bangkok (2005)<ref name=":0" />
* Honorary guest professor at the Department of Ion Physics and Applied Physics, [[University of Innsbruck|Innsbruck University]] (since June 2009)<ref name=":0" />
